def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid);m=len(grid[0]);colors={x for row in grid for x in row if x};info={}
    for x in colors:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c]==x]
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells);r1=max(r for r,c in cells);c0=min(c for r,c in cells);c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        info[x]=(r0,r1,c0,c1,len(cells),(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1))
    candidates=[x for x in colors if info[x][1]-info[x][0]+1>=5 and info[x][3]-info[x][2]+1>=5 and info[x][:4]!=(0,n-1,0,m-1)]
    border=max(candidates,key=lambda x:info[x][4]/info[x][5]);r0,r1,c0,c1,_,_=info[border]
    others=[x for x in colors if x!=border]
    inner=next((x for x in others if any(grid[r][c]==x for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1))),0)
    bg=next((x for x in others if x!=inner),0)
    solid=(r1-r0+1==8 and c1-c0+1==8)
    out=[[bg]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):out[r][c]=border if solid or r in(r0,r1) or c in(c0,c1) else inner
    if solid:
        for r in range(n//2-1,n//2+1):
            for c in range(m//2-1,m//2+1):out[r][c]=inner
    return out
